caption: The drawing depicts the upper portion of a building façade with a balcony running across the entire visible width. The building features four tall rectangular windows with multiple panes, each flanked by louvered shutters. The balcony has an ornate metal railing with vertical bars and decorative scrollwork along the top edge. Above the windows, there is a roof overhang supported by evenly spaced angled brackets, and the cornice is decorated with a repeating ornamental pattern and finial-like details along the edge. The drawing is rendered in shades of blue and gray, using fine lines and shading to indicate architectural details and depth. The composition is set within a rectangular border, with the building viewed from a low angle, emphasizing the perspective upwards toward the roof.
title: Cast Iron Work
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
